args.title: Add missing S3_ENDPOINT setting and bucket creation to local setup
args.body:
File: README.md

Add a line to the 'Running locally' steps to mention setting the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable to http://localhost:9000 when using MinIO, and also mention creating the bucket in the MinIO console before uploading. This clarifies the setup and avoids confusion about upload destinations.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue reports missing instructions in the local setup steps about setting the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable for MinIO and the need to create the bucket manually in the MinIO console. The README.md's 'Running locally' section should be improved with these clarifications to help new users successfully configure MinIO for local testing.
